l-m-e3-b05-02.s.s1.r.d: Di product na even and both numbers na even too. Na example wey fit di claim.

l-m-e3-b01-26.material: Sort word-problem cards ‘multiplication’ and ‘not multiplication’. Choose good sorting rule.
l-m-e3-b01-26.s.s1.prompt: Which rule good for identifying multiplication problems?
l-m-e3-b01-26.s.s1.o.a: Are there groups with same number?
l-m-e3-b01-26.s.s1.r.b: Even big numbers fit addition/subtraction problem.
l-m-e3-b01-26.s.s1.r.c: Object names dey every kind problem.
l-m-e3-b01-26.s.s1.r.d: Text length no concern calculation needed.
l-m-e3-b01-26.s.s1.explain: If several groups of same number, one multiplication fit find answer. Na standard.
l-m-e3-b01-26.s.s2.model.0: If several equal groups, use one multiplication, so na criterion.
l-m-e3-b01-26.s.s2.model.1: Number size or text length no decide calculation, so no be criteria.

l-m-e3-b01-34.title: How you go take decide di size of circle with compass?
l-m-e3-b01-34.goal: Work out which standard (information) dem must have to know di size of circle wey dem draw with compass, and explain why you choose am.
l-m-e3-b01-34.material: You wan draw circle with compass. Think about wetin you need to know to decide di size of di circle wey you go draw.
l-m-e3-b01-34.s.s1.prompt: Wetin dem must have to decide di size of circle?
l-m-e3-b01-34.s.s1.o.a: Di time wey e take to draw di circle
l-m-e3-b01-34.s.s1.r.a: Di time wey e take no get anything to do with di size of di circle.
l-m-e3-b01-34.s.s1.o.b: How far dem open di compass
l-m-e3-b01-34.s.s1.r.c: Color no get anything to do with di size of di circle.
l-m-e3-b01-34.s.s1.o.d: Only where to put di compass point
l-m-e3-b01-34.s.s1.r.d: Di position decide only di center. E no decide di size.
l-m-e3-b01-34.s.s1.explain: Di length wey dem open di compass na di radius, so dis length decide di size of di circle.
l-m-e3-b01-34.s.s2.model.0: Di length wey dem open di compass na di radius, so dis length decide di size of di circle.
l-m-e3-b01-34.s.s2.model.1: Di position of di point decide only di center, so dem fit make circles of different sizes from di same center.

l-m-e3-b02-06.title: How many times you go need pour to fill di water bottle?
l-m-e3-b02-06.goal: To find out how many times you go need cup to fill di water bottle, pick which standard (information) must dey, and explain why you choose am.
l-m-e3-b02-06.material: One cup hold 250 mL, and di water bottle na 2 L. You wan know how many times you go need pour to fill di water bottle reach top with di cup.
l-m-e3-b02-06.s.s1.o.a: To multiply 2 and 250 as dem be
l-m-e3-b02-06.s.s1.r.a: To multiply numbers wey get different units no dey give di number of times.
l-m-e3-b02-06.s.s1.o.b: To look di shape of di water bottle
l-m-e3-b02-06.s.s1.r.b: You no fit know how many times to pour from di shape alone.
l-m-e3-b02-06.s.s1.o.c: To change L to mL, then divide by 250
l-m-e3-b02-06.s.s1.o.d: To add 2 and 250 as dem be
l-m-e3-b02-06.s.s1.r.d: Di units no be di same, so you no fit add dem as dem be.
l-m-e3-b02-06.s.s1.explain: 2 L=2000 mL, so 2000÷250=8 times. You must make di units match first.
l-m-e3-b02-06.s.s2.model.0: You must change 2 L to 2000 mL to compare am with 250 mL, so you go find am with 2000÷250.
l-m-e3-b02-06.s.s2.model.1: Di units no be di same, L and mL, so you must make dem match to one unit and then divide to get di number of times.

l-m-e3-b02-07.title: Wetin you need know to find how many boxes dem need?
l-m-e3-b02-07.goal: To find out di number of boxes wey dem need, pick which standard (information) must dey, and explain why you choose am.
l-m-e3-b02-07.material: You wan put 45 pencils inside boxes, 9 pencils for each box. You wan know how many boxes dem need.
l-m-e3-b02-07.s.s1.o.a: Di total number of pencils and di number of pencils for each box
l-m-e3-b02-07.s.s1.r.b: Di color no get anything to do with di number of boxes.
l-m-e3-b02-07.s.s1.r.c: Di length no get anything to do with di number of boxes.
l-m-e3-b02-07.s.s1.r.d: Even if you know di price, you no fit know how many boxes.
l-m-e3-b02-07.s.s1.explain: To divide di total of 45 pencils by di 9 pencils for one box give 45÷9=5 boxes.
l-m-e3-b02-07.s.s2.model.0: You need know di total number of pencils and di number of pencils for each box to divide, so dis information must dey.
l-m-e3-b02-07.s.s2.model.1: Di length, price, or color no dey tell you how many boxes, so dem no necessary.

l-m-e3-b02-08.title: Which one long pass, homework or reading?
l-m-e3-b02-08.goal: To find out which of two activities take longer, pick which standard (information) must dey, and explain why you choose am.
l-m-e3-b02-08.material: Homework take 1 hour 20 minutes, and reading take 85 minutes. You wan know which one take longer.
l-m-e3-b02-08.s.s1.o.a: To choose di bigger number between 20 and 85
l-m-e3-b02-08.s.s1.r.a: 20 na only di minutes part, so you no fit compare am with 85.
l-m-e3-b02-08.s.s1.o.b: To compare 1 hour and 85 minutes as dem be
l-m-e3-b02-08.s.s1.r.b: Hours and minutes na different units, so you no fit compare dem as dem be.
l-m-e3-b02-08.s.s1.o.c: To think say di activity wey dem do first na di one wey long pass
l-m-e3-b02-08.s.s1.r.c: To do am first no mean say e take longer.
l-m-e3-b02-08.s.s1.o.d: To change both to minutes and compare
l-m-e3-b02-08.s.s1.explain: 1 hour 20 minutes=80 minutes, and 85 minutes long pass. You must make di units match to compare.
l-m-e3-b02-08.s.s2.model.0: 1 hour 20 minutes na 80 minutes, so if you compare for di same unit of minutes, 85 minutes long pass.
l-m-e3-b02-08.s.s2.model.1: Di units no be di same, hours and minutes, so you no fit compare dem as dem be. You must change dem to minutes.

l-m-e3-b02-09.goal: To find out di sizes of two fractions wey get di same denominator, pick which standard (information) must dey, and explain why you choose am.
l-m-e3-b02-09.material: You wan decide which fraction big pass, 5/9 or 7/9. Di two fractions get di same denominator.
l-m-e3-b02-09.s.s1.r.a: Di denominators na di same, so to compare dem no make any difference.
l-m-e3-b02-09.s.s1.r.c: How you read am no dey decide di size.
l-m-e3-b02-09.s.s1.o.d: Whether di denominator na even number
l-m-e3-b02-09.s.s1.r.d: Di denominators na di same, so even or odd no get anything to do with di comparison.
l-m-e3-b02-09.s.s1.explain: If di denominators na di same, di pieces get di same size. 7/9, wey im numerator (di number of pieces) big pass, na di greater one.
l-m-e3-b02-09.s.s2.model.0: If di denominators na di same, di pieces get di same size, so you just compare di numerators, wey be di number of pieces.
l-m-e3-b02-09.s.s2.model.1: Both denominators na 9, so no difference dey, and you must compare di numerators 5 and 7.

l-m-e3-b02-10.goal: To find out di number of students wey one bar stand for, pick which standard (information) must dey, and explain why you choose am.

l-m-e3-b02-10.s.s1.o.d: Di number of letters for di bar name

l-m-e3-b02-10.s.s2.model.0: You must know di number wey one square stand for and di number of squares for di bar to multiply and find di number of people, so dem necessary.
l-m-e3-b02-10.s.s2.model.1: Di color or di number of letters no dey tell you di number of people, so dem no necessary to read am.

l-m-e3-b03-06.title: Wetin you need to know to find out how much more money to save to reach di goal?
l-m-e3-b03-06.goal: Sort out which criterion (information) must dey needed to find out how much more money to save to reach di goal, an explain why you choose am.
l-m-e3-b03-06.material: You dey save money for piggy bank. Your goal na to save 5000 won. You wan find out how much more money you need to save to reach di goal.
l-m-e3-b03-06.s.s1.o.a: Di money wey you don save so far
l-m-e3-b03-06.s.s1.o.b: Di money wey you save per day
l-m-e3-b03-06.s.s1.r.b: Di daily amount alone no dey tell you how much you don save now.
l-m-e3-b03-06.s.s1.o.c: Di number of days of saving
l-m-e3-b03-06.s.s1.r.c: Even if you sabi di number of days, you no fit know di money wey you don save.
l-m-e3-b03-06.s.s1.o.d: Di color of di piggy bank
l-m-e3-b03-06.s.s1.r.d: Di color no get anything to do with di amount of money wey you don save.
l-m-e3-b03-06.s.s1.explain: If you subtract di money wey you don save so far from di goal of 5000 won, e go give di money wey still remain to save.
l-m-e3-b03-06.s.s2.model.0: You need to subtract di money wey you don save so far from di goal amount, so you must know di money wey you don save.
l-m-e3-b03-06.s.s2.model.1: Di color of di piggy bank or di number of days no dey tell you di remaining amount, so dem no dey needed.

l-m-e3-b03-07.goal: Sort out which criterion (information) must dey needed to find out di sizes of two four-digit numbers, an explain why you choose am.
l-m-e3-b03-07.material: You wan decide which one big pass, 4507 or 4570. Think about which digits you need to compare.
l-m-e3-b03-07.s.s1.r.a: If you compare only 7 an 0, you go judge wrong say 4507 big pass.
l-m-e3-b03-07.s.s1.o.b: Di first place wey di digits differ
l-m-e3-b03-07.s.s1.r.c: Both sums na 16, so dem dey same, an you no fit tell di size.
l-m-e3-b03-07.s.s1.r.d: Di number of 0s no get anything to do with size.
l-m-e3-b03-07.s.s1.explain: Compare from di highest place an look di first place wey differ. For di tens place, 0 an 7, 4570 big pass.
l-m-e3-b03-07.s.s2.model.0: Di thousands an hundreds places dey same, 4 an 5, so you only need to compare di first place wey differ, di tens place 0 an 7.
l-m-e3-b03-07.s.s2.model.1: You skip digits wey dey same from di highest place, so di first place wey differ go decide di size.

l-m-e3-b04-06.goal: Decide which criterion (information) dem truly need to find out how long train ride take, and explain di reason for your choice.
l-m-e3-b04-06.material: Train leave from one station and reach another station. We wan know how long di train ride take. Make we think about which information dem truly need.
l-m-e3-b04-06.s.s1.o.a: Di departure time and di arrival time
l-m-e3-b04-06.s.s1.o.b: Di price of di train ticket
l-m-e3-b04-06.s.s1.r.b: Di price no get anything to do with di time wey e take.
l-m-e3-b04-06.s.s1.r.c: Even if you know di number of cars, you no fit know how long e take.
l-m-e3-b04-06.s.s1.o.d: Di number of people wey dey board
l-m-e3-b04-06.s.s1.r.d: Di number of people no tell you di time wey e take.
l-m-e3-b04-06.s.s1.explain: Di time wey e take na di time from di departure time reach di arrival time. Dem must get both times.
l-m-e3-b04-06.s.s2.model.0: If you know di departure time and di arrival time, you fit count di time between dem, so dem must get dem. Di number of cars and di price no get anything to do with time.
l-m-e3-b04-06.s.s2.model.1: Di time wey e take dey between di two times, so dem need di departure and arrival times. Di number of people and di price no tell you di time.

l-m-e3-b04-07.s.s1.r.a: Di size of di writing no get anything to do with di rule of di numbers.
l-m-e3-b04-07.s.s1.o.b: Only check whether di first number na odd
l-m-e3-b04-07.s.s1.r.b: To look only di first number no decide di next number.
l-m-e3-b04-07.s.s1.o.d: Whether di last number big pass 100
l-m-e3-b04-07.s.s1.r.d: Di size of di last number alone no tell you di rule.
l-m-e3-b04-07.s.s1.explain: If you look how much di numbers wey dey near each other change, you go see say 3, 8, 13, 18 follow rule of growing by 5 each time.

l-m-e3-b05-08.goal: Work out which rule (piece of information) dem must get to choose correct unit for distance, then explain why you choose am.
l-m-e3-b05-08.material: E take 15 minutes to waka from school reach di nearest post office. Think about di rule for whether e better to talk dis distance for m or km.
l-m-e3-b05-08.s.s1.prompt: Which one na correct rule to choose unit?

l-m-e3-b02-14.s.s2.model.1: E be one share when dem divide di whole equally by di denominator, so 12÷6=2 items na 1/6.

l-m-e3-b03-30.s.s2.model.0: The 1st na 2, the 2nd na 4, and the 3rd na 6, and all of dem equal 2×□, so we fit write the pattern as 2×□.
l-m-e3-b03-30.s.s2.model.1: Every time the position go up by 1, the number dey grow by 2, so the expression na □ multiplied by 2.

l-m-e3-b03-35.s.s2.model.1: B wrong because B subtract 50 minutes from 20 minutes by swapping di order, even though dem no fit do am.

l-m-e3-b05-35.s.s2.model.1: Because dividing into 3 sweets each like B give 2 groups wey be 1/2, e no be 1/3.
